correctness.rationale: The proof derives exact original-update transitions, an r-independent embedded Markov jump chain, a bounded martingale giving fixation probabilities, transient occupation sums weighted by Doob h, exact geometric holding times and finite power sums yielding A_l,B_l,C_l. The positive harmonic difference C_l-A_l proves strict convexity and unique minimizer. A standalone standard-library checker independently enumerated every labelled transient state, solved exact rational linear systems, and agreed on 128 assertions; no finite test is used as proof of a universal quantifier.

value.rationale: The established environmental graph model has selection-independent fixation probability on proper colourings, leaving meaningful ambiguity about *successful-trajectory duration*. The exact all-star harmonic law reveals that fixation speed has a unique nonneutral optimum although fixation probability is constant. The structural result separates jump-chain geometry from parameter-dependent waiting times and yields a reproducible finite-population benchmark and quantified large-star limit; no ungrounded empirical claims.
